description: Elegant, fancy, smooth macOS UI: liquid-glass window with subtle translucency + blur, rounded corners, smooth typing and subtle animations, matched-character highlighting, and a clipboard sidecar preview panel shown only for images or overflowing text.

userStories.title: Liquid-glass window background and rounded corners
userStories.description: As a user, I want the launcher window to look like liquid glass (subtle blur, low transparency) with rounded corners so it feels elegant while keeping text clearly readable.
acceptanceCriteria: Window uses NSVisualEffectView material .hudWindow
Low transparency maintains clear readable text
Rounded corners are visibly applied (~16px)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Scope: window + search + results; follow system appearance (light/dark).

userStories.title: Subtle slide+fade animations for results updates
userStories.description: As a user, I want results updates to feel smooth and fancy (subtle motion) without jitter while typing.
acceptanceCriteria: Result list updates animate with subtle slide+fade
Animation timing is very subtle (100–150ms)
No visible jitter while typing
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Prefer respecting Reduce Motion if feasible.

userStories.title: Matched-character highlighting in app and clipboard results
userStories.description: As a user, I want matched characters highlighted in the results so scanning is faster.
acceptanceCriteria: Matched characters are accent-colored (NSColor.controlAccentColor)
Highlight works in both application and clipboard modes
Highlight remains readable on glass background
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use fuzzy match positions if available; otherwise implement minimal match-index support.

userStories.title: Expose match indices from fuzzy matcher (if required)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need match indices from the fuzzy matcher so UI can highlight matched characters accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Fuzzy matching can return score plus matched character indices
Existing ranking behavior remains unchanged
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Only implement if current matcher cannot provide positions.

userStories.title: Clipboard sidecar preview panel scaffold
userStories.description: As a user, I want a right-side preview extension (sidecar panel) that matches the glass UI so I can preview clipboard items without changing the main list layout.
acceptanceCriteria: A separate sidecar panel can be shown/hidden programmatically
Sidecar panel matches main window height and uses medium width (~320px)
Sidecar matches glass styling and system theme
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Presentation: sidecar panel with small gap; clipboard mode only.

userStories.title: Clipboard preview visibility rules + rendering
userStories.description: As a user, I want the preview sidecar to appear only when needed (images or overflowing text) and show the content clearly.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidecar appears only when selected clipboard item is an image
Sidecar appears when clipboard text does not fit in the main window single-line row
Sidecar stays hidden otherwise
Text preview uses smart formatting (wrap normal text; monospace for code-like)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Main window rows remain single-line; preview is a separate panel.

userStories.title: Smooth typing performance pass
userStories.description: As a user, I want per-keystroke search updates to stay instant and smooth even with animations and a large clipboard history.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing remains responsive under large clipboard history
No stutters or lag during per-keystroke updates
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Optimize UI updates and avoid unnecessary heavy work per keystroke.
